description: MakeAppx accepts an invalid `en-UK` resource language that later prevents package installation, based on https://github.com/microsoft/WindowsAppSDK/issues/5636.
prompt: My hand-built package passes MakeAppx, but `Add-AppxPackage` fails on another machine with a manifest/resource error. The package has only English resources, and I set the language to `en-UK` because the app is for UK customers.
